Question:
What is true of the four sides of a square?

[Figure 1](figures/cnm_p077_q2_question_en.svg)

Choices.A: All four sides are equal in length
Choices.B: Only opposite sides are equal in length

Solution: All four sides of a square are equal in length, so A is correct. A square is a rectangle with this additional equal-side property.
